oracle.name: Dataverse Web API (hosted environment)
oracle.scope: Two hosted runs on 2026-11-27 (dc2a, dc2b) of eighteen rollup columns per run, each created empty and saved by the classic rollup designer (opened from the Maker column panel) and read back from the run's Solution export, recorded under observed rollupCreateState not-calculated: Minimum and Maximum of a decimal, a date and time and a date-only column; option-set, Boolean, decimal and UTC date filters with Equal (one or several checked options), NotEqual, Null, NotNull, GreaterThan, GreaterEqual, LessThan and LessEqual joined by And; hierarchical Sum and filtered Maximum; a hierarchical Sum of the source table's own column; hierarchical Counts with a source filter. Invented parent and child schema with hierarchies P1, P2, P3 and P5, P6, P7, an empty P4 and a deactivated child. Establishes the stored values and states after seeding and the CalculateRollupField value and state (a null value absent); dates and response annotations are not recorded.
